hooks.command: echo '--- Pre-commit: Type checking ---' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; TSC_EXIT=$?; echo '--- Pre-commit: Checking for TODO/FIXME comments in staged files ---' && TODOS=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$' | xargs grep -n -E '(TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX):' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$TODOS" ]; then echo "$TODOS"; TODO_COUNT=$(echo "$TODOS" | wc -l); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Pre-commit check found $TODO_COUNT TODO/FIXME comment(s) in staged files:\n$TODOS\"}}"; fi; if [ $TSC_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"TypeScript type check failed. Fix errors before committing."}'; fi
